guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest anomaly (latency-90 +913%, z=+182) and its CPU rose about 7x (2.66 to 18.78, z=+36). recommendationservice, which calls it, slowed too, which fits a downstream effect, and the worst traces all pass through productcatalogservice with no errors logged.

proposed_fix.description: Check productcatalogservice for CPU saturation (a hot loop or a heavy query), raise its CPU limit or add replicas, and restart the pod only if it stays pinned. Mem and socket also rose moderately, which looks like a side effect of load, so confirm against pod-level profiling.
